item.title: Highway 74: A Disaster Waiting to Happen?
item.description: A growing number of crashes, close calls, and firsthand accounts are raising urgent concerns about safety on California’s Highway 74. With a state study delayed until 2027, commuters and experts alike are questioning why immediate action hasn’t been taken.

item.title: Palm Springs Tourism Push: Smart Strategy or More Red Tape?
item.description: Palm Springs is launching a new tourism advisory committee aimed at boosting visitor appeal while protecting local quality of life. The move raises questions about whether the city is refining its strategy—or adding another layer of bureaucracy.

item.title: Shift in Strategy: Trump Signals Openness to Talks with Iran After Escalation Threats
item.description: A sudden shift in U.S. strategy is raising new questions about the future of the conflict with Iran, as President Donald Trump signals a willingness to pursue talks after days of escalating rhetoric.Just days ago, the president dismissed the idea of a ceasefire, even threatening to target Iran’s power infrastructure if key shipping routes were not reopened. item.title: Rattlesnake Season Returns: Are You Watching Your Step?
item.description: As temperatures rise in Southern California, rattlesnakes are becoming more active on local trails. Experts say most encounters can be avoided with simple awareness—but getting too close can quickly turn dangerous.

item.title: Riverside County Showdown: Will Perez and Sanchez Face Off?
item.description: With the primary election approaching, calls are growing for a public debate between two key candidates vying for a Riverside County supervisor seat. Voters may soon get a chance to hear directly from both sides—if the debate happens.

item.title: Deadly Crash, Light Sentence: Justice Served or System Failure?
item.description: A San Francisco sentencing is igniting outrage after an elderly driver who killed a family of four avoided prison time. Critics say the punishment falls far short of accountability for such a devastating loss.

item.title: Ballot Battle: Candidates Blocked or System Breakdown?
item.description: Two Riverside County candidates say they did everything right—only to be denied a spot on the ballot. Now, a legal fight is underway that could determine whether voters get a real choice in the upcoming election.

item.title: Jerry's SoCal Weather Briefing on Tuesday, March 24, 2026!
item.description: The Coachella Valley will be under sunny skies this afternoon with dew points around 50° and peak temperatures in the upper-90s.You can expect another sunny day for Wednesday, but with occasionally gusty on-shore winds, drier air and midday highs around 100°.Clouds thicken this weekend followed by a few changes next week. As of today, it looks like a couple of disturbances will move through the Southwest pulling-down high temps to the 80s beginning Tuesday, March 31.Stay tuned for updates!@Jerry

item.title: Average Riverside County Gas Price Rises For 55th Time in 56 Days
item.description: RIVERSIDE (CNS) - The average price of a gallon of self-serve regulargasoline in Riverside County rose today to its highest amount since Oct. 9,2023, increasing 3.1 cents to $5.794. The average price has risen 55 of the past 56 days, increasing$1.653, including 2.5 cents on Monday, according to figures from the AAA andOil Price Information Service. item.title: Deliberations Begin in Trial of Woman Accused of Murdering Indio Motel Guest
item.description: MURRIETA (CNS) - Jury deliberations began Monday in the trial of a 35-year-old Arizona woman accused in an unprovoked deadly shooting at an Indiomotel. Carla Sharese Flores allegedly killed 27-year-old Ashley Brito ofThousand Palms at the City Center Motel in 2021. Flores is charged with first-degree murder and sentence-enhancing gunand great bodily injury allegations.
